run_checkers_main: run the checkers main CLI to execute a named checker against the repository
test_CheckerCache_is_current: test the CheckerCache is_current method to verify if a checker cache entry is still valid
test_CheckerCache_update: test the CheckerCache update method to refresh the cache entry for a given checker
test_run_checker: test the run_checker function to execute a checker and capture its exit code and output
test_SlidingWindow: test the SlidingWindow class to verify output display behavior in TTY and non-TTY environments
